description: Available connections for [Kubernetes Connector](https://dt-url.net/qx03q4d). A connection is bound to a Kubernetes cluster where the workflow actions operate. We recommend following the steps described [here](https://dt-url.net/mf03qvf) using the Dynatrace Operator, which automatically creates the connection.

uid.description: A pseudo-ID for the cluster, set to the UID of the kube-system namespace

constraints.customMessage: The provided Cluster UID is invalid

namespace.description: The namespace where EdgeConnect is deployed

token.description: The token required by EdgeConnect to access the ServiceAccount token.

constraints.customMessage: For security reasons please re-enter the token before saving the configuration.
